verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear left-image / right-copy split with the headline and a strong CTA leading, but 'CLINICALLY TESTED' has moved from eyebrow to below the body copy and been enlarged into a competing line, the product jar has shrunk to a tiny chip in the bottom-left corner, and the legal block is cramped and unreadable. B makes the Lumen & Fig logo oversized so it competes with the headline, shrinks the CTA, and drops the legal text into an awkward mid-canvas strip between the image and the jar. B also has the same enlarged 'CLINICALLY TESTED' problem, and its jar and logo blocks look disconnected from the rest of the layout.
